title: Joperson Trazo faces ‘Filipino slayer’ in Thailand title fight

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano boxing prospect Joperson Trazo will put his name to the test when he makes his overseas debut against Thai veteran Thananchai Charunphak for the World Boxing Council (WBC) Asian flyweight title on October 30 in Nonthaburi, Thailand. The Talisay City native faces a daunting challenge against Charunphak, a seasoned campaigner with 32 wins, 16 knockouts, and two losses, who has earned a reputation as a “Filipino slayer” after beating seven Filipino boxers.
